race.comment: CROWN OF RUSSIA (1) was really good fresh over a mile. Slow to begin and always well back but stormed home from last on the turn to just miss. Record is far better than it looks, tackling stakes class at three in feature races over a bit of ground. Worth noting sole career win was when second-up. Fitter and can go one better. RAZANNE (8) is going well in similar races and os overdue. Hard fit and should be in the finish. FIERCE FIASCO (4) has been freshened since a maiden win last time at Seymour. Can go on with it. AZEOLA (7) was a winner two back then safely held last time out in much tougher company. Gets chance to atone.
